<ic>Create an liaison from the Conclave with the power to address the Senate</ic>

===Overview===
* Passed unanimously

===Date===
* Winter 377YE

===Campaign Outcome===
A new [[Imperial title]], the [[Conclave Liaison to the Senate]] has been created. The title will be appointed by declaration of the Conclave and has the power of address in the [[Senate]].
* The title was [[Amend powers of the Conclave Liason|amended]] at the Autumn Equinox 378YE summit, and the title changed to be [[Imperial Magus]].
